describes: packages/core/acrojs: color conversion, action-tree sources, the field view, seeds, identity, and the shipped constants.

cases.name: css-nan-propagates
cases.covers: Math.max and Math.min propagate NaN, and NaN.toString(16) is "NaN".

cases.name: from-css-keeps-nel
cases.covers: U+0085 is not JavaScript whitespace, so it stays and the value is invalid.

cases.name: from-css-astral
cases.covers: Length is counted in UTF-16 units: "a" plus one astral character is three.

cases.name: is-color-space-coerced
cases.covers: String(["RGB"]) is "RGB": the space is coerced before the lookup.

cases.name: is-color-space-prototype-member
cases.covers: counts["toString"] is a function, never a count.

cases.name: sources-depth-first
cases.covers: Root, then /Next depth-first; only javascript nodes are collected (a rendition /JS is not).

cases.name: fields-from-snapshot
cases.covers: Every value-entry kind, the Off token for toggles, and options only where the DTO has them.

cases.name: seed-astral-hashes-the-high-surrogate
cases.covers: for...of walks code points and charCodeAt(0) takes the first UTF-16 unit, so the low surrogate never enters the hash.
